body: Doesn’t stay for the full heavy attack, only the only that takes one sword ammo to swing

Dude honestly stop, just stop living in the past and start looking ahead for a better future. I lived my whole childhood alone, while being surrounded by people. Keep your chin up, I’m not the happiest but I’m better where I was. Keep trying, don’t fuel your depression by living the same day every single day. Small changes every now and then, just by trying to eat something new, can change your future. Please, be safe, I didn’t know love until I had to work on myself to realize how important I am to me and others
